scope: Git history and working tree secret hygiene: tokens, passwords, OAuth secrets, Discord/Nitrado keys, cookies, private keys, webhook secrets, fixtures, docs.

contracts.noTrackedEnv: .env must not be tracked; only .env.example with placeholders
contracts.currentTreeScan: Tracked non-binary sources must not match high-risk secret regexes
contracts.redaction: Observability/export paths redact secrets (DEV redaction architecture)
contracts.historyNote: Full git log --all -S scans are CI-optional; Stage 39 freezes current-tree gate + documents process for history

followUp.item: Optional CI job: gitleaks/trufflehog on full history at Gate phase
